What to Expect From Your Consultation

Each consultation is delivered by encrypted video call and follows the same clinical standards as an in-person specialist appointment. Your endocrinologist will:

  • Take a full clinical and family history relevant to your hormone or metabolic health
  • Review any existing test results, scans or letters you provide
  • Assess your current symptoms and disease control
  • Explain findings clearly and discuss an appropriate management plan
  • Advise on next steps, including further testing, in-person review, or referral where needed

Conditions Commonly Assessed

Our endocrinology consultation supports a wide range of hormone and metabolic concerns, including:

Diabetes & Blood Sugar

  • Type 1 and Type 2 diabetes management
  • Prediabetes and blood sugar concerns
  • Diabetes control review and lifestyle guidance

Thyroid Conditions

  • Underactive thyroid (hypothyroidism)
  • Overactive thyroid (hyperthyroidism)
  • Thyroid nodules and goitre review
  • Thyroid function test interpretation

Hormonal Health

  • PCOS and menstrual hormone concerns
  • Menopause and perimenopause symptoms
  • Testosterone and male hormone concerns
  • Adrenal and cortisol-related concerns

Weight & Metabolism

  • Metabolic syndrome
  • Weight-related hormonal assessment
  • Cholesterol and lipid concerns linked to hormone health

Bone Health

  • Osteoporosis risk and bone density concerns
  • Vitamin D and calcium imbalance

Not sure your situation fits here? Book a consultation and your specialist will guide you. If in-person investigation is needed, you'll be clearly advised.

Avoid long public waiting lists. Same-week appointments are typically available.
